author: Kat
title: Paid human illustrator for short-story series
content: Looking for a human artist for some small, paid illustration work. NO AI ART. No AI tools. I want to pay an actual artist for actual art. I am writing a series of short stories, and as I finish each one, I am planning to release them digitally for free. Eventually they will all be compiled into a physical book, so I do not need full cover designs for every individual story. Looking for a small black-and-white illustration for each story that gives Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark feeling. 12 stories planned. Artist would get credit. Contact via DM on this post / Threads.

author: colli.ns258
title: Urgent original artwork for personal project
content: URGENTLY LOOKING FOR ARTIST. Need some original artwork done for a personal project. Looking for a creative person who can follow references but still add their own touch. Good communication is important. Budget: £70–£115. Beginners with decent samples can apply too. Contact via DM on Threads.

author: Veli Raiya
title: Fantasy book map designer + character illustrator
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely does not have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you are a fantasy author recommending someone you have personally worked with. See the next posts for more details on what I am looking for with each. Contact via DM on Threads.

author: blekek.k
title: Illustrators for trading card project (incl. Pokemon/TCG)
content: Hi warga threads! We are looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We are looking for artists that draw anime/manga style illustrations, cartoon/semi-cartoon illustration, Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork, semi-realistic illustrations, and any other art styles. Comment if you are interested or DM me directly!

author: Tee Yuan Xin
title: Freelance graphic designer for ads and posters
content: Looking for a Freelance Graphic Designer. Currently looking for someone who can support us on upcoming client projects, mainly for social media visuals, ads creatives, campaign posters, simple visual adaptations / resizing. Prefer someone who has a good eye for clean and modern design, can follow brand guidelines / references well, is responsive and able to meet deadlines, and is comfortable handling ad and social media creatives. Contact via DM on Threads.
